opportunities.what: Halvard and Cobaltine both asked for a Benelux freight/distribution cost benchmark, and Tomás has a reusable Benelux rate dataset ready. Build one benchmark from it that serves both clients.

Brennholt moved its full-day Bremen workshop to 10 December, the same day Maren committed to present in person at Halvard's steering committee in Rotterdam. Propose a different date to Klaus instead of confirming.
Ravi wants to talk to someone who rolled out 24/7 shift scheduling software; Klaus at Brennholt just did and offered to share his experience. Offer an intro between them.

Cobaltine's retainer renewal is up for discussion in early December while finance rejects a second unclear invoice and the sales team abandoned the stale dashboard. Prepare a save plan: corrected invoices, dashboard fix with Tomás, and the renewal options.

Tomás invoiced 52 Halvard hours, but Halvard's PO caps subcontracted work at 40 hours unless a change request is approved first. Sort out the 12 extra hours (change request to Owen or agree with Tomás) before paying and billing.

traps.what: Overdue invoices at Halvard and Brennholt, but an open to-do already covers chasing both.
Petra and Owen both could not open the shared folder, but Petra later said their IT fixed it for both.
Two proposal requests are the same person (Ravi) writing from his work and personal addresses.
Sister's bakery pricing (personal) and Cobaltine's price increase (work) share a topic but must not be combined.
Cobaltine and Brennholt both needed a signed data processing agreement, settled over 45 days ago.
'Kestrel' is Halvard's WMS project and Cobaltine's granola brand: unrelated.
